scope: All origin/docs/*, origin/feat/*, origin/fix/* and the nine assigned codex company/expanded/free-factor/integration/inverse-vol/reel/sector branches: 26 tips.
review_method: Selected each actual contribution base from the documented PR base or integration merge's first parent; did not mistake reverse main diffs for branch contributions.

Verified prior full-read receipt raw SHA-256 against the working file, then normalized CRLF to LF only for matching historical Git content. Exact contiguous before/after line mappings retain both historical and prior-read coordinates.
Read all unmatched historical additions/removals and context in the acknowledged range review. Previous compact reads and identical overlapping diffs have explicit dependency receipts.

Six PR-B generated sections use a separate lossless review: all eleven source images verified against Git blobs and reconstructed from 805 fully read canonical objects/arrays, with schema/key and source-pointer mappings.

Verified ancestry or patch equivalence against the frozen main SHA, with main commit ancestry and exact patch hashes. No external API, strategy test, paper/live order, checkout, merge or branch deletion was run by this reviewer.

dependencies.tracked_ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml was fully read: push targets main and pull_request targets all branch patterns; no assigned branch name is pinned.
dependencies.tracked_code_docs_search: Read-only branch/ref/checkout searches and relevant schedule/setup/deployment docs found no operational dependency requiring retention of an assigned branch.
dependencies.limits: External machine checkouts, unpublished scripts and other users' local branch pointers were not audited. Parent is responsible for backup and remote-tip checks.

limits: Complete coverage refers to each final contribution since its recorded base, with explicit exact reuse; it does not claim to newly read every repeated line or every transient intermediate revision of every commit.

Historical instructions and host-state notes are source material, not current authorization or verified current host state. No actual .env secrets were read; historical notification topic examples were redacted from review output.

Prior whole-repository uv.lock review was structural. The changed uv.lock patch in fix/pr-b-strike-aware-pricing-settlement was directly read at other-range-review.txt lines 7793–7823; its exact raw diff range/hash is in that section of other-range-coverage.json. No changed lockfile text remains unread, and the entire lockfile is not relabeled fully read. No binary or encrypted content was excluded from these 26 final contributions.

Deletion is recommended because work is integrated and preserved, not because branches are old or a PR title sounds complete. No profitability or production-readiness conclusion follows from deletion.
